info.title: Investment Factory portfolio API contract
info.description: Sol technical design, 2026-11-08. Contract-first; routes are planned interfaces, not a claim of deployed endpoints. C01 core covers portfolio, holdings, targets and safe decimal records. Valuation/preview interfaces have explicit financial-data and policy gates. No brokerage orders or provider credentials.

servers.description: Local FastAPI development; not deployed by this document.

post.summary: Create empty portfolio with zero cash

201.description: Created with zero cash and holdings

patch.summary: Change name or reporting preference without rewriting records

post.summary: Normalize identity for a user-entered owned instrument
Register current inventory without recording a purchase

delete.summary: Remove an inventory record; never a brokerage sale

204.description: Removed inventory; persisted plans/snapshots are unchanged.

get.summary: Get dated current valuation or explicit unavailability
get.x-implementation-gate: C02 and financial policy; not part of core CRUD delivery

post.summary: Calculate what to buy and quantity without executing a purchase
post.x-implementation-gate: Feature 004, C02/C03, approved trading/fees/scoring policy and real data; no fake ready result

200.description: Ready scenario or explicit blocked calculation

Decimal.description: Exact nonnegative decimal text; preserve accepted user-entered spelling. No exponent, grouping or binary float.

Currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code; actual supported currencies validated by backend.

code.description: Stable machine code; UI localizes known codes and provides a generic localized fallback.

detail.description: Sanitized explanation; no raw provider response or credential.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with stable code and field pointers. Trace IDs never contain secrets.

Portfolio.description: New portfolios have zero holdings and one zero cash balance in the initial reporting currency. A preview budget does not alter these balances. Changing reporting currency never rewrites stored original-currency entries.

ticker.description: Trim and normalize case in the backend.

Instrument.description: Registration identifies an owned instrument; it does not discover investments or invent market prices. Normalized exchange/ticker identity is unique.

HoldingWrite.description: Inventory snapshot, not a purchase. On create and full replacement, omitted cost/date become null; they are never inferred from a quote.

Holding.description: Exactly one current holding per portfolio and instrument; writes replace quantity rather than silently adding a purchase.

TargetNode.description: Flat acyclic tree with implicit portfolio root (parent_id=null). Layer kinds may be skipped, not repeated/reversed on a path. Each nonempty sibling set sums exactly 100, including root children; leaf groups need no sum. Investment nodes are leaves and require instrument_id; other nodes require null.

Targets.description: An empty allocation is a valid initial configuration. Replacing targets is atomic; invalid input preserves the old tree.

Quote.description: A ready calculation uses only a real, dated, policy-valid quote. Missing/stale data is represented by the unavailable branch, never by zero.

FxRate.description: One unit of base equals rate units of quote. Same-currency conversions need no fabricated provider quote.

AllocationValue.description: Current percentage and deviation are null when the invested-value denominator is zero. Cash is reported separately; the business policy for nonzero cash in allocation is not silently chosen here.

Valuation.description: Current valuation only. Historical cost/gain and policy for nonzero-cash percentages are separate; return unavailable if required policy or data is absent.

ContributionPreviewRequest.description: What-if new contribution amount, independent from the persisted starting cash of zero. This POST does not fund an account, change holdings, place orders or record actual purchases.

ContributionPreviewReady.description: Original budget = allocated budget + remaining budget in the original budget currency using exact decimals. The sum of estimated_budget_cost equals allocated_budget. Only owned, eligible investments within hierarchy/caps may receive buys; quantity obeys an explicitly approved trading policy. Empty recommendations with all budget left are valid when no permissible purchase fits.

ContributionPreviewBlocked.description: No estimated costs or quantities. Reasons include missing holdings/targets, stale/missing prices or FX, unresolved scoring/trading/fee policy. Never invent a recommendation to populate the UI.

PortfolioCreated.description: Creation guarantees the owner's known-zero initial state.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong portfolio ETag returned by GET. Missing gives 428; outdated gives 412; never silently overwrite concurrent edits.

schema.description: Opaque stable ordering cursor. Invalid cursor is 422.

Problem.description: Structured request, concurrency, upstream or server error. Error responses never contain raw provider payloads.
